description: macOS-style Dynamic Island for Windows with media controls, dashboard, calendar, timer, file shelf, system information, and quick actions.
notes: The official v1.0.0 ZIP contains WinDynamicIsland.exe at its archive root. The release README describes the build as self-contained, but the actual WinDynamicIsland.runtimeconfig.json in the downloaded ZIP declares a framework dependency on Microsoft.NETCore.App 8.0.0, and the ZIP contains no bundled coreclr.dll/hostfxr.dll runtime files. The release workflow runs dotnet publish with a win-x64 RuntimeIdentifier but does not pass --self-contained true or set SelfContained; for .NET 8, a RuntimeIdentifier alone defaults to framework-dependent deployment.

The project sets WindowsAppSDKSelfContained=true, which does not make the separate Microsoft.NETCore.App runtime self-contained. The app needs .NET 8 Runtime. This bucket suggests versions/windowsdesktop-runtime-8.0 because that official Scoop package installs the .NET Runtime together with the additional Windows Desktop Runtime; the app's runtimeconfig itself requests only Microsoft.NETCore.App.
Settings, notes, shelf data, and logs are stored under %LOCALAPPDATA%\\WinDynamicIsland. The optional Run-at-startup setting is controlled by the application and is not enabled by this manifest.
